class.jaymoskingdoms.option.glass_shards: A fan of black glass splinters that cut and open wounds.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.glass_spires: A row of glass spikes comes up out of the ground ahead of you, lifting and slowing whoever stands there.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.glass_skin.d: A coat of glass that turns blows and cuts the hand that lands one. It bursts after five. A held spell.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.molten_glass: A glowing pool where you look. It burns, then cools hard round the feet of whoever is still in it, then shatters.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.fire_ring.de: A ring of fire round you that burns and throws back whoever crosses it. A held spell.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.fire_pillars: Three columns of fire that turn about you. A held spell.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.fire_lance.d: A stream of fire where you look, for as long as you hold it. It can meet another stream head on.
A forbidden art. A flame that water will not put out, and that leaps once to whoever stands nearest.
A coat of lightning: quick feet, a shock for whoever strikes you, and an arc to a foe close by. A held spell.
